items.title: Pay gas annual settlement balance
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Period starts from invoice date 27.11.2026 (day of the event not counted, §187 I BGB). 30 calendar days end on 27.12.2026, which is a Sunday. Under §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day: Monday 28.12.2026 (not a public holiday in NW).

warnings: The 30 days run from the invoice date (27.11.2026), not from receipt, so the payment window is shorter than it looks.

The 30th day (27.12.2026) is a Sunday. The date was moved to Monday 28.12.2026 under §193 BGB. To be safe, pay by Friday 25.12.2026 (a public holiday) or earlier, for example Thursday 24.12.2026. Banks need processing time over Christmas.
